assumptions_made: the record is a finite ensemble of discrete sampled trajectories
predictor and target values at the same grid index are contemporaneous

three_level_distinction.A_observational_sampled_trajectory: x_s(t_{s,k}), y_s(t_{s,k}) - the finite task-level samples carried by O_rec; this is what the study possesses
three_level_distinction.B_numerical_realization: any smoother, interpolant, finite-difference rule or derivative estimator later applied to construct a coordinate; a declared analyst choice, not a property of the data
three_level_distinction.C_latent_physical_trajectory: not observed directly and not assumed exactly recoverable
three_level_distinction.consequence: a later derivative-valued coordinate is a constructor acting through a declared numerical realization of a sampled trajectory, NOT evidence that the samples possess an exact classical derivative

support.mask_defined_from: observational and numerical support only, never reconstruction performance
